# README header assets

Light and dark headers used at the top of the repository `README.md` (same pattern as Externa and laravel-oidc).

## Brand kit (Decision 2026-11-13)

Luca decided that Signaculum README headers should be generated from the knowledge brand kit at `projects/qiick/brand/signaculum/`, like the other qiick repos.

**This environment does not have that brand kit mounted.** The committed `header-light.svg` and `header-dark.svg` are **placeholders** (Signaculum rose palette from `resources/css/qiick-theme-signaculum.css`: accent `#A24A7B` / mark `#DC77AD`). Replace them with the real lockup art from the brand kit before announcing the release; keep the same file names and the `picture` / `prefers-color-scheme` block in the README.
